investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 — All Remote Agent Checks Failing on POST /api/agents
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-31T04:59Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm gateway ELB in us-east-2 was unreachable during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs at the very first network hop to the swarm backend — before any agent identity, VM ID, or state can be returned — all required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) are absent and every contract assertion is unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning endpoint) was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api layer returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" on every POST /api/agents attempt, preventing agent creation from starting and leaving all required evidence fields unpopulated. This is an infrastructure-layer failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency, not to the eval runner logic or the expected-output contract definitions. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact is confirmed only at the eval layer.

investigation.title: image-generation-stream Eval Failure: OpenAI API Credit Balance Exhausted on /api/generate/image/stream
investigation.summary: The image-generation-stream eval failed because the OpenAI API key used by the eval environment has no remaining credits, causing the upstream image generation call to return a hard error (code: credit_balance_exhausted). The stream terminated with a generation_error frame instead of the required generation_completed frame, so both contract assertions — frameTypes containing "generation_completed" and imageUrlPresent equaling true — were violated. This is an eval infrastructure failure caused by an exhausted external API billing quota; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
investigation.rootCause: The OpenAI organization account associated with the API key used by the eval runner has exhausted its credit balance. When the eval runner called /api/generate/image/stream (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs, line 1984), the AURA backend forwarded the request to OpenAI, which rejected it with HTTP error type "insufficient_quota" and code "credit_balance_exhausted". The stream emitted generation_start and generation_progress frames before receiving the error, then emitted a generation_error frame with GENERATION_FAILED and terminated without ever emitting generation_completed or an image artifact URL. Both required contract assertions therefore failed. The failure is localized to the eval runner's OpenAI credential/billing configuration, not to the AURA image generation routing or streaming logic itself.
